annotations.title: Check an AI input against its source

description: Garbage-in guard. Check whether a piece of data is genuinely vouched for by its claimed source domain (a sebbi Verified Source that hosts /.well-known/sebbi-source.json). Returns GENUINE, UNVERIFIED or UNKNOWN, sealed into Bitcoin. Call this before trusting an input.

hash.description: Or the SHA-256 of the data, instead of the text
